summary.zh: 找出技术债并按影响排序，给出重构优先级
summary.en: Find and rank tech debt so you know what to refactor first.

description.zh: 扫描代码库里的重复逻辑、过度耦合、过时依赖和缺失测试，按修复成本与影响排序，输出可执行的清理清单。适合规划重构迭代、接手遗留项目或判断代码健康度。需要读取完整仓库。
description.en: Scans for duplicated logic, tight coupling, stale dependencies and missing tests, then ranks findings by effort and impact into a cleanup list. Plan a refactor sprint, take over legacy code or gauge code health. Needs full source access.
